prompt.en: Discover Canada says Labrador has a very large supply of one kind of energy. Which kind?
prompt.fr: Découvrir le Canada dit que le Labrador possède d'immenses ressources d'un certain type d'énergie. Lequel?

explanation.en: Fast-moving water in Labrador is used to make electricity. The guide calls those hydro-electric resources immense, which means very large.
explanation.fr: L'eau qui coule avec force au Labrador sert à produire de l'électricité. Le guide qualifie ces ressources hydroélectriques d'immenses, c'est-à-dire très grandes.

source.quote: Labrador also has immense hydro-electric resources

verification.evidence: Today off-shore oil and gas extraction contributes a substantial part of the economy. Labrador also has immense hydro-electric resources.
